notes: The first visitor who completes Getting Started becomes the administrator. Claim the instance immediately; additional users are created by the administrator.

Immich v3.3.1 stores uploads in /data. CPU machine learning uses /cache; the release-specific PostgreSQL image includes VectorChord and pgvectors. All persistent storage uses separate named volumes, with no host mounts or hardware acceleration.
Only the Immich server publishes a loopback port. PostgreSQL and Valkey stay private; TZ=Etc/UTC replaces the upstream /etc/localtime host mount.

Upstream requires at least 6GB RAM for the stack, recommends 8GB, and requires x86-64-v2 on amd64 for machine learning v3. The application floor and ML limit are 2g each; PostgreSQL is explicitly limited to 2g because upstream requires at least 2GB when resource-limited. Measured live (8GB box): server peaks at about 58% just after first start and idles near 40%; ML holds about 1GB (48%) once its models are loaded; PostgreSQL about 25%.

The panel nginx upload limit follows the application post_max_size setting, which defaults to 128M. A single photo or video larger than that is rejected until the existing application setting is raised.

Exact release images and upstream dependency digests were verified for linux/amd64. Verified live on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 (RC-18): every image ref below is in its tested list. Machine learning downloads its models on first use, so the container needs outbound internet.
